# Facet integration smoke fixtures

Synthetic, fictional stations, authored before T25 inference. These test plumbing and source-linked answers, not real-world knowledge or broad retrieval quality. The single-page native-text `cobalt.pdf` says: "The fictional Cobalt station has 7 sensors." All inputs are frozen in `manifest.json`; tests must verify hashes, never regenerate files.

Predeclared checks: Aster opening year 2017 (automatic fields); follow-up director Maya Chen; combined Aster panels 17 / Boreal antennas 29; PDF Cobalt sensors 7; exact JSON amount, zero and raw null; absent Aster builder → insufficient evidence. Every answer uses opted-in facet coverage, original document scope and source validation. Do not tune on these cases or call them an independent benchmark. Deterministic tests cover invalid plans/model outputs, ambiguous/rejected states, scope and context limits.
